images.md5_reference: Installed torchvision 0.29.0+cpu, torchvision.datasets.OxfordIIITPet._RESOURCES; not an official published SHA256.

annotations.md5_reference: Installed torchvision 0.29.0+cpu, torchvision.datasets.OxfordIIITPet._RESOURCES; not an official published SHA256.

mirror.sha256_reference: Hugging Face LFS object SHA256 at the frozen dataset revision, verified by the calling agent; not Oxford tar checksums.
mirror.ground_truth_basis: Oxford breed annotations carried by the mirror's label/image_id/label_cat_dog columns and frozen card label_names; no direct reading of official annotation text or official tar archives is claimed.

mapping_policy: Manually approved, frozen 20 dog-breed aliases to the zero-based ImageNet-1K V1 canonical category table. Never extend by model predictions, fuzzy matching, or nearby breed names.

limitations: The prepared data cover 20 manually mapped dog breeds, not the complete 37-class Oxford dataset or full ImageNet-1K validation set.
Official breed annotations are ground truth; no model prediction is used as a label or selection filter.
The source trainval split supplies calibration/development; the source test split supplies final holdout only.
JPEG-byte SHA256, source identity and EXIF-normalized decoded RGB pixel SHA256 checks do not guarantee absence of near duplicates.
Official source split separation does not prove the pretrained ImageNet models have never seen these images or related images.
Calibration labels are null; breed metadata are for stratification, not post-calibration accuracy claims.
